definitions.gloss: snow removal; snow clearing; snow plowing
definitions.explanation: The act of clearing accumulated snow from roads, sidewalks, rooftops, and other surfaces. A common winter activity in snowy regions of Japan, especially in Hokkaido and the Japan Sea side.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}から{除雪|じょせつ}{作業|さぎょう}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Snow removal work was carried out from the morning.

examples.japanese: {大雪|おおゆき}で{除雪|じょせつ}が{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない{地域|ちいき}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: Some areas couldn't keep up with snow removal due to the heavy snowfall.

examples.japanese: {雪国|ゆきぐに}では{毎朝|まいあさ}{家|いえ}の{前|まえ}の{除雪|じょせつ}をするのが{日課|にっか}になっている。
examples.english: In snow country, clearing snow in front of the house every morning is part of the daily routine.

notes:
USAGE:
Can function as a する verb ({除雪|じょせつ}する). Very common in news reports during winter, especially regarding road conditions in northern Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {除雪|じょせつ}{作業|さぎょう} (snow removal work)
- {除雪|じょせつ}{車|しゃ} (snowplow)
- {除雪|じょせつ}{費|ひ} (snow removal costs)
- {屋根|やね}の{除雪|じょせつ} (clearing snow from rooftops)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雪|ゆき}かき: shoveling snow — the everyday, informal word for physically shoveling snow by hand
